notes: Chinese annals record Ho-ling (Ka-ling) embassies 766-873, ancestor Ki-yen's capital further east; van der Meulen identifies Sanjaya's 732 Yava with Ho-ling. 732 marks Sanjaya's inscription, not an end. Inscription reports disorder after Sanna's death. Identification debated.
